subject: Quick check on the dates?
text: Hey there, hope your week's going well. I wanted to gently follow up since it's been a couple of days since we last chatted, mainly because I'd love to make sure I'm understanding the deadlines correctly. The timeline I have is: first draft ready by Friday, feedback from your side on Monday, then final version delivered Wednesday. If that's not quite right, just tell me what you were thinking, and I'll adjust my schedule around you. I'm really looking forward to getting this moving and making it work for your team. Please tell me what makes the most sense for you before I finalize scheduling.
